# maxplus2-mcp — MAX+plus II MCP Server

> Local, agent-independent Model Context Protocol server for Altera MAX+plus II
> (MAX+PLUS II, MaxPlus II, MaxPlus2). 数字电路实验：GDF 原理图、SYM 符号、SCF 波形、编译仿真。

## Project
- [Canonical repository](https://github.com/Hachimeder/maxplus2-mcp): MIT-licensed source and issues.
- [中文介绍](https://github.com/Hachimeder/maxplus2-mcp/blob/main/README.md): 安装、能力、限制和验证证据。
- [English introduction](https://github.com/Hachimeder/maxplus2-mcp/blob/main/README.en.md): Setup, capabilities, limits and verification evidence.
- [Release downloads](https://github.com/Hachimeder/maxplus2-mcp/releases/latest): Runtime ZIP, source ZIP, MCPB bundle, registry metadata and SHA-256 checksums.
- [Discovery and connection](https://github.com/Hachimeder/maxplus2-mcp/blob/main/docs/DISCOVERY.md): Registry lookup, GitHub search, exact project identity and stdio configuration.
- [Tool reference](https://github.com/Hachimeder/maxplus2-mcp/blob/main/docs/TOOLS.md): 68 MCP tools and input schemas.
- [Format coverage](https://github.com/Hachimeder/maxplus2-mcp/blob/main/docs/FORMATS.md): Decoded formats and remaining limitations.
- [Verification evidence](https://github.com/Hachimeder/maxplus2-mcp/blob/main/docs/VERIFICATION.md): Portable and native test evidence.

## Registry identity
Server name: io.github.Hachimeder/maxplus2-mcp
Transport: local stdio. This repository is not a remotely hosted MCP endpoint.
Registry API: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers?search=maxplus2&version=latest

## Requirements and scope
Node.js 18+; no npm dependencies. Native compilation, simulation and desktop control
require Windows, a separately installed and licensed MAX+plus II, and for desktop
control .NET Framework 4.8 with an interactive unlocked desktop. File operations
are portable. No vendor application, device library or license is distributed.
The Windows backend is included as source and does not depend on Codex Computer Use.
Discovery does not install the server: configure a local MCP client, then inspect
tools/list and call detect_install before native operations. SCF is supported;
support for Quartus VWF is not implied. Hardware programming is not verified.
